items.description: Lack of standardized Ultra-Low-Volume (ULV) drone spray water dilution calibration and aerial application safety buffers for paddy.
items.safety_impact: HIGH (Risk of chemical phytotoxicity or drift hazard if drone concentrated spray is improperly diluted)
items.user_impact: HIGH (Increasing number of farmers adopting drone custom hiring services require official water/dosage guidelines)
items.evidence_gap: Current corpus specifies knapsack high-volume water rates (500 L/ha) but lacks certified CIBRC/TNAU ULV drone guidelines (20-25 L/ha, 8-10 L/acre).
items.authoritative_source_required: CIBRC SOP for Drone Application in Agriculture (2022/2024); TNAU Drone Technology Center Advisory Bulletin
items.proposed_solution: Incorporate structured drone spray frontmatter attributes in chemical evidence records with explicit water volumes and wind drift restrictions (<10 km/h).
items.validation_required: Automated drone safety gate test asserting water dilution validation and wind warning.
items.expert_review_required: Agricultural Engineering & Entomology Specialist sign-off required.

items.description: Emerging Rice False Smut (Ustilaginoidea virens) infections during high-humidity flowering in Cauvery Delta.
items.affected_crop: Rice (Late Samba / Thaladi crops, ADT 45, CR 1009)
items.safety_impact: MEDIUM (Farmer attempts to spray during full bloom may cause spikelet sterility)
items.user_impact: HIGH (Severe panic among farmers when grain turns into yellow/greenish-black velvety spore balls)
items.evidence_gap: Corpus currently covers Bacterial Leaf Blight, Blast, Sheath Blight, and Tungro, but lacks False Smut preventive boot-stage management.
items.authoritative_source_required: ICAR-IIRR Rice Diseases Compendium; TNAU Crop Production Guide (Paddy Section 7.4)
items.proposed_solution: Author new RAG document DOC-DIS-005 (Rice False Smut) with verified boot-leaf stage preventive fungicide timing (Copper Hydroxide 77 WP @ 1.25 kg/ha or Propiconazole 25 EC @ 500 ml/ha) and strict nitrogen limitation.
items.validation_required: Gold integration test suite and agronomic accuracy benchmark on False Smut queries.

items.description: Stem Rot (Sclerotium oryzae) disease in ill-drained lowland paddy fields causing premature lodging.
items.user_impact: MEDIUM (Lodging at maturity causes 15-30% harvest grain loss)
items.evidence_gap: Missing structured disease frontmatter and SES damage rating scale for Stem Rot.
items.authoritative_source_required: TNAU Agritech Crop Protection - Rice Stem Rot Management; IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank
items.proposed_solution: Create DOC-DIS-006 with primary cultural recommendation (field drainage, burning stubbles) and curative spray (Hexaconazole 5 EC @ 1000 ml/ha or Validamycin 3 L @ 1000 ml/ha at water line).
items.validation_required: Differential diagnostic test against Sheath Blight to verify zero diagnostic confusion.

items.description: Southern Tamil Nadu dialect term 'வெங்காயத்தாள் புழு' (onion-leaf caterpillar) for Gall midge (Orseolia oryzae) tubular silver galls.
items.user_impact: MEDIUM (Requires clarification turn rather than direct one-turn resolution)
items.evidence_gap: Term is present in TAMIL_PEST_LEXICON.csv with status 'NEEDS_REVIEW' but lacks formal extension validation sign-off.
items.authoritative_source_required: AC&RI Madurai / KVK Ambasamudram Regional Farmer Survey 2025-2026
items.proposed_solution: Validate term with Southern Zone entomology extension officers and upgrade status to 'VERIFIED' in v4.3 candidate lexicon.
items.validation_required: Southern Tamil dialect ASR & NLU entity resolution benchmark.

items.description: Kongu regional dialect term 'மட்ட பூச்சி' refers to paddy sheath mite (Steneotarsonemus spinki), currently causing ambiguity.
items.user_impact: MEDIUM (Farmers in Erode/Bhavanisagar reporting panicle chaffiness due to mite infestation)
items.evidence_gap: Lexicon does not currently contain 'மட்ட பூச்சி' as an independent mite entity.
items.authoritative_source_required: TNAU Department of Agricultural Entomology Sheath Mite Bulletin
items.proposed_solution: Add 'மட்ட பூச்சி' -> PEST_009 (Sheath Mite) with acaricide prescriptions (Spiromesifen 22.9 SC @ 500 ml/ha or Wettable Sulphur 80 WP @ 1 kg/ha) into candidate queue.

items.description: Structured multi-turn diagnostic rule for physiological Zinc Deficiency (Khaira disease) vs fungal Brown Spot (Bipolaris oryzae).
items.affected_region: All Tamil Nadu (Particularly alkaline/calcareous Delta soils)
items.affected_entity: Nutritional Chlorosis vs Fungal Foliar Spots
items.safety_impact: LOW (Prevents unnecessary chemical fungicide spraying on nutritional deficiencies)
items.user_impact: HIGH (Farmers frequently spray expensive fungicides when only Zinc Sulphate + Urea foliar spray is needed)
items.evidence_gap: Need explicit differential diagnostic decision tree mapping midrib rusty pigmentation to Zinc and oval lesions with yellow halos to Brown Spot.
items.authoritative_source_required: TNAU Department of Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Micronutrient Guidelines; IRRI Rice Diagnostic Decision Tree
items.proposed_solution: Implement a structured RAG diagnostic disambiguation prompt node that prompts farmer for lesion pattern before confirming prescription.

items.description: Whorl Maggot (Hydrellia philippina) high-resolution verified reference image missing from repository (IMG-0018).
items.safety_impact: NONE (Application safely uses text description without displaying misleading imagery)
items.user_impact: MEDIUM (Farmers requesting visual confirmation cannot view reference symptom photo in mobile app)
items.evidence_gap: Dataset v4 archive contains 0 verified photos for Whorl maggot (7 of 8 classes populated).
items.authoritative_source_required: Field collection from TRRI Aduthurai / TNAU Paddy Breeding Station during Samba nursery cycle
items.proposed_solution: Execute scheduled field photography mission during September 2026 Samba nursery season; capture serrated leaf margins and central whorl damage; verify with entomologist and record SHA-256 and CC-BY-NC 4.0 metadata.
items.validation_required: Image manifest validation and computer vision benchmark.
items.expert_review_required: Entomology Department verification of specimen in photo.

items.proposed_solution: Finalize institutional open-access educational attribution documentation in manifests/image_manifest.csv.
items.validation_required: Automated license compliance check in repository readiness suite.

items.description: Biological input Pseudomonas fluorescens application timing and compatibility intervals with chemical fungicides.
items.safety_impact: LOW (Farmers mixing bio-agents with chemical fungicides kill the living bacterial culture)
items.user_impact: MEDIUM (Ensures farmers achieve maximum biological protection against sheath rot and blast)
items.evidence_gap: Need explicit frontmatter attribute specifying mandatory 7-day separation interval between bio-control application and chemical fungicide sprays.
items.authoritative_source_required: TNAU Department of Plant Pathology Bio-inoculant Guidelines
items.proposed_solution: Embed biological agent incompatibility rules in chemical safety gate module.
items.validation_required: Chemical safety gate suite test on tank-mix bio-agent queries.

items.description: Acoustic tractor and diesel pump engine noise interference (75-85 dB) impacting low-resource IndicConformer ASR word error rate.
items.safety_impact: NONE (NLU hotword dictionary currently recovers 98% of entities)
items.user_impact: LOW (Occasionally causes 1-word phonetic distortion in noisy pump-shed environments)
items.evidence_gap: Acoustic training data has high ambient field coverage but lacks synthetic 80 dB farm machinery noise injection.
items.authoritative_source_required: BHOOMI Rural Voice Field Acoustic Collection Project
items.proposed_solution: Augment ASR fine-tuning corpus with farm machinery noise profiles (tractor, diesel pump, thresher, rain on tin shed).
